title: Local comparison inequality for weak limits of minimizing currents (Simon 7.2.4, (1)–(11))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and T_j (j ∈ ℕ), T ∈ 𝒟_n(U). Assume: (i) each T_j is minimizing in U (contract IsMinimizingIn T_j U: T_j is integer multiplicity and M_W(T_j) ≤ M_W(S') whenever W is open with closure(W) compact and contained in U, S' ∈ 𝒟_n(U) is integer multiplicity, ∂S' = ∂T_j, and spt(S' − T_j) is a compact subset of U ∩ W); (ii) sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U; (iii) T_j ⇀ T in U; (iv) T is integer multiplicity. Then for every compact K ⊆ U and every ε > 0 there exist an open set W with K ⊆ W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) := {x : |x − y| < ε for some y ∈ K} (Mathlib Metric.thickening ε K) and closure(W) compact and contained in U, a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and numbers e_j ∈ [0, ∞] with e_j → 0, such that M_W(T_{φ(j)}) ≤ M_W(S) + e_j for every j ∈ ℕ and every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with ∂S = ∂T and spt(S − T) ⊆ K.
